research_question: When does an implementation-induced numerical difference become directional training bias and then persistent parameter drift?
headline: A conditional transported-orbit-mean persistence signal is supported for the LM-head reduction/VJP family across two new operand distributions, but no universal all-operator property is established.

coverage.duplicate_deep_measurements: one representative per exact implementation pattern

evidence: Phi lm_head dX: local centered, parameter-gradient biased, effective-update biased; norm-preserving residual/transport pairing removes gradient bias.
Llama 3.2 and Ministral 3: frozen transported-orbit predictor risk before consequence; retrospective strict 4+4 cross-fit retained risk on both models.
Repeated per-step semantics-preserving orbit null retains comparable drift, so schedule randomization alone is not a sufficient explanation.
source_orbit_mean.scope: exact finite semantic orbit, closed F+B/VJP boundary, complete parameter coordinates, and the measured LM-head reduction family

backward_transport.claim: A centered local difference can become directional after semantic backward transport or saved-state reconstruction.
backward_transport.boundary: The interventions are empirical composite/semantic-region mechanisms; they do not prove a single universal transport factor.

feedback_sustained.claim: Adam state can sustain drift after local formation is centered.
feedback_sustained.boundary: This is a consequence/feedback channel, not source-persistent Flash-style evidence.

variance_only_or_canceling.boundary: These are controls under the stated protocol, not universal safety proofs.

unresolved.reason: compiler/provenance/graph closure failed before a valid formation measurement

predictive_test.prospective_ordering: prediction is frozen before consequence trajectories

null_and_persistence.interpretation: one-shot noise is rejected; closed-loop feedback remains active, so source causality is not isolated by this null

final_claim: The project delivers a Bias Formation Map and a falsifiable, conditional transported-orbit-mean predictor for one mathematically defined reduction/VJP family. It does not claim that every operator has this mechanism or that every unresolved endpoint is safe.
next_if_extended: freeze an implementation-class held-out pool that contains both predictor-positive and residual-nonzero predictor-negative cases
obtain at least one genuinely new implementation-class positive, or formally freeze the narrow family-scoped claim
separate feedback prediction from source prediction before testing feedback-sustained cases
